value.rationale: For a motivated mortality-cost mechanism, the theorem classifies every feasible migration fraction and identifies the exact global cost cutoff and distinct local slope cutoff. Their nonempty separation gives an explicit failure of incremental policy improvement, plus a robust example where zero migration goes extinct but complete movement grows. This is a natural complete two-patch seasonal benchmark, not a synthetic parameter slice or a generic numerical example; larger landscapes and real conservation recommendations are not claimed.
